C09-M02-L04-F1.title: Where things sit inside an E01 image
C09-M02-L04-F1.caption: The main sections of an E01 image from left to right: added structure around the compressed media chunks, with the stored media hash near the end.
C09-M02-L04-F1.alt: Row of seven boxes. File header (slate, every segment): signature and segment number. header / header2 (violet, first segment): case metadata, compressed. volume (blue, first segment): sector size, sector count, chunk size. sectors (orange, widest, data segments): media data as 32 KiB chunks. table / table2 (blue, data segments): chunk offsets, two copies. hash / digest (dark, last segment): stored media MD5, SHA-1 in later writers. done / next (slate): done closes the last segment, next ends the others. Note: only the orange box holds source bytes, so the hash of a .E01 file is never the media hash.
C09-M02-L04-F1.note: Only the orange box holds source bytes, so the hash of a .E01 file is never the media hash.

C09-M02-L04-F2.title: Which hash may be compared with the acquisition record
C09-M02-L04-F2.caption: Choosing a valid comparison method for raw and E01 images, and the common mistake that produces a meaningless mismatch.
C09-M02-L04-F2.alt: Decision graph. Dark start node: Compare with recorded media hash. It leads to two blue nodes: Raw image (single or split) and E01 segment set. Raw leads to green Hash the file(s) in order. E01 leads to green Decode chunks, hash stream, and by a dashed arrow labelled common mistake to red Hash a .E01 file directly, which leads only to slate Not comparable. Both green method nodes lead to a decision node, Same as the receipt value?, whose yes branch reaches green Values match and whose no branch reaches orange Values differ, whose sub-label says check value, set and order, then escalate and record.
